findings.reason: a node dispatched to this deliverable would guard a state the system does not produce and leave the real driver of `ended-without-manifest` (the worker-liveness gap) unfixed, so the 32 observed halts would persist.
findings.text: §27 states "`exit.json` still held attempt 5's exit" after the resume advanced `attempt.json` to attempt 6, but the resume path unlinks the canonical exit record at every new attempt, so `_run_exit_record` already returns None for a resumed attempt and the proposed guard is a no-op for the observed halt
